about: Graphics drivers the player does not render on with the GPU (round record doc/process/rounds/2026-10-render-modes.md §3.2). Built into the host (playback/render_denylist.rs); a file of the same shape at <app data>/render-denylist.json adds rules or replaces them by id ({"id": ..., "disabled": true} switches one off). Fields follow Chromium's software_rendering_list.json: os {type, build}, vendor_id, device_id, driver_version {op, value, value2}, exceptions; action cpu (software rendering), software-windows (software rendering and Slint's software renderer for the windows) or warn (a note only). Versions compare part by part as numbers; op is <, <=, =, >=, > or between (both ends included).

rules.description: AMD Radeon 780M driver 31.0.14005: GPU draws stall for tens of milliseconds (p95 52 ms) and 4K60 video drops to about 40 fps

AMD Radeon 780M driver 32.0.32015.7029 (Adrenalin 26.10.1) and later: OpenGL (femtovg) windows show only white, plugin windows too, while the frame log counts 60 presented frames per second; Slint's software renderer draws them correctly
